column2: [intro]
We step into this cozy café,
Where smiles light up every face.
With a glass in hand, we toast to cheer,
Here, all our troubles disappear.
In the bistro, the mood is bright,
We sing and laugh, and feel delight.
In the bistro, joy is all around,
Join me here where happiness is found.
An accordionist plays with flair,
The waiters dance through the air.
Friends and strangers, a festive crew,
In this bistro, we bid our blues adieu.
In the bistro, the mood is bright,
We sing and laugh, and feel delight.
In the bistro, joy is all around,
Join me here where happiness is found.
[ solo ]
So come to this charming place,
Where love and laughter fill the space.
Here, everything’s a joyful sight,
In this warm haven that feels so right.
[ outro ]
